items.qr: Wakate giin wa seikai no sedai (a. koutai b. shinkou) no hitsuyousei o uttaeta.
items.en: The young lawmaker argued for the need for generational change in politics.
items.why: 世代交代 (generational turnover/changeover) is the fixed phrase; 新興 is an adjective for something newly established (a religion, a neighborhood) and doesn't pair with 世代.

items.q: 彼らは双子だが、性格は（a.対照 b.対称）的だ。
items.qr: Karera wa futago da ga, seikaku wa (a. taishou b. taishou) teki da.
items.en: They're twins, but their personalities are a study in contrast.
items.why: 対照的 describes two things being different/opposite (fits "contrasting personalities"); 対称 describes mirror-image symmetry (shapes, designs), not personality traits.

items.q: 人質（a.解放 b.開放）のニュースが伝えられた。
items.qr: Hitojichi (a. kaihou b. kaihou) no nyuusu ga tsutaerareta.
items.en: News of the hostage's release was reported.

opts.en: opening (a place to the public — wrong word)

items.why: 人質を解放する is the fixed phrase for releasing a hostage; 開放 is for opening up a place or facility (a school, a border), not freeing a person from captivity.

items.q: 交通費は会社から（a.支給 b.支持）される。
items.qr: Koutsuuhi wa kaisha kara (a. shikyuu b. shiji) sareru.
items.en: Transportation costs are paid by the company.
items.why: 支給 is for a company/organization paying out money or goods; 支持 is for supporting a person, party, or opinion, not for issuing an allowance.

items.q: 野外音楽会の開催を（a.企画 b.避難）する。
items.qr: Yagai ongakkai no kaisai o (a. kikaku b. hinan) suru.
items.en: Plan the holding of an outdoor concert.
items.why: 企画する is the verb for planning/organizing an event; 避難する means to evacuate to safety and has no connection to concert planning.

items.q: ハンドル（a.指示 b.操作）を誤って事故を起こす。
items.qr: Handoru (a. shiji b. sousa) o ayamatte jiko o okosu.
items.en: Cause an accident through a steering error.
items.why: ハンドル操作 (steering operation) is the set phrase for physically handling a wheel/control; 指示 refers to giving/receiving verbal instructions, not physically operating machinery.

items.q: 経済状況は（a.以前 b.依然）として厳しい。
items.qr: Keizai joukyou wa (a. izen b. izen) toshite kibishii.
items.en: The economic situation remains severe.
items.why: 依然として is the fixed adverbial phrase for "remaining unchanged"; 以前 simply means "before/formerly" as a point in time and can't take としてin this sense.

items.q: （a.形成 b.形勢）が逆転し、チームは優勝した。
items.qr: (a. Keisei b. Keisei) ga gyakuten shi, chiimu wa yuushou shita.
items.en: The situation reversed, and the team won the championship.

opts.en: the state of a competitive situation

items.why: 形勢逆転 (a reversal of the game situation) is the book's own listed compound; 形成 refers to the formation/development of something (like personality), which doesn't "reverse" in a match.

items.q: 台風のため、電車が一時（a.不通 b.非難）になった。
items.qr: Taifuu no tame, densha ga ichiji (a. futsuu b. hinan) ni natta.
items.en: Because of the typhoon, trains were temporarily suspended.
items.why: 電車が不通になる is the set phrase for train service being suspended; 非難 means to criticize/blame someone and has nothing to do with service disruptions.

items.q: 事件の（a.契機 b.核心）に迫る情報はなかった。
items.qr: Jiken no (a. keiki b. kakushin) ni semaru jouhou wa nakatta.
items.en: There was no information that got to the heart of the case.
items.why: 核心に迫る is the fixed phrase for "getting to the heart of" a case; 契機 means an opportunity/trigger that starts something, unrelated to what a piece of information "reaches."

items.q: 新市長は（a.抱負 b.負債）を述べた。
items.qr: Shin-shichou wa (a. houfu b. fusai) o nobeta.
items.en: The new mayor stated his aspirations.
items.why: 抱負を述べる is the set phrase for stating one's aspirations/resolutions; 負債 (debt) is a financial term with no place in an inaugural speech about hopes.

items.q: 転倒した選手は（a.閉口 b.棄権）せず、最後まで滑りきった。
items.qr: Tentou shita senshu wa (a. heikou b. kiken) sezu, saigo made suberikitta.
items.en: The skater who fell didn't withdraw, and skated to the very end.
items.why: 棄権する is the verb for withdrawing from a competition; 閉口する describes being at a loss/annoyed by something (like a rude question), unrelated to competing.

items.q: 製品に（a.危険 b.欠陥）が見つかった。
items.qr: Seihin ni (a. kiken b. kekkan) ga mitsukatta.
items.en: A defect was found in the product.
items.why: 欠陥が見つかる is the set phrase for "a defect is found" (in a product); 危険 describes a state of danger, not a discoverable flaw itself.

items.q: 今回の最優秀賞には（a.該当 b.確信）者がなかった。
items.qr: Konkai no saiyuushuushou ni wa (a. gaitou b. kakushin) sha ga nakatta.
items.en: There was no eligible recipient for this round's top award.
items.why: 該当者 (an eligible/qualifying person) is the fixed term for someone meeting award criteria; 確信 means personal conviction and doesn't describe eligibility.

items.q: 田中夫妻は社交的で、話題が（a.豊富 b.共作）だ。
items.qr: Tanaka fusai wa shakouteki de, wadai ga (a. houfu b. kyousaku) da.
items.en: The Tanakas are sociable, with a wealth of topics to talk about.
items.why: 話題が豊富 (an abundance of topics) is the set phrase for a sociable, talkative person; 共作 refers to a jointly-created work (a song, a book), not a store of conversation topics.

items.q: 炭には脱臭、つまり臭いをとる効果がある。
items.qr: Sumi ni wa dasshuu, tsumari nioi o toru kouka ga aru.
items.en: Charcoal has a deodorizing effect — that is, it removes odors.
items.why: Day 1's すみ group — 炭 (charcoal) shares the kun-yomi すみ with 墨 (ink) and 隅 (corner).

items.q: 候補者たちが街頭で演説をしている。
items.qr: Kouhosha-tachi ga gaitou de enzetsu o shite iru.
items.en: The candidates are giving speeches on the street.
items.why: Day 6's がいとう group — 街頭 (a street/public place) shares this reading with 該当 (eligible).

items.q: 情報技術革新により、為替取引はオンライン、リアルタイムで可能だ。
items.qr: Jouhou gijutsu kakushin ni yori, kawase torihiki wa onrain, riarutaimu de kanou da.
items.en: Thanks to innovation in information technology, currency trading is now possible online, in real time.
items.why: Day 6's かくしん group — 革新 (innovation) shares this reading with 核心 (the core) and 確信 (conviction).

items.q: この書類を至急届けてください。
items.qr: Kono shorui o shikyuu todokete kudasai.
items.en: Please deliver this document urgently.
items.why: Day 5's しきゅう group — 至急 (urgent) shares this reading with 支給 (to pay out).

items.q: 年配の方には敬意を払うべきだ。
items.qr: Nenpai no kata ni wa keii o harau beki da.
items.en: One should show respect to one's elders.
items.why: Day 5's けいい group — 敬意 (respect) shares this reading with 経緯 (circumstances).

items.q: 公害訴訟は和解が成立した。
items.qr: Kougai soshou wa wakai ga seiritsu shita.
items.en: A settlement was reached in the pollution lawsuit.
items.why: Day 5's こうがい group — 公害 (pollution) shares this reading with 郊外 (the suburbs).

items.q: 規格外野菜を安く購入する。
items.qr: Kikakugai yasai o yasuku kounyuu suru.
items.en: Buy off-standard (irregularly-shaped) vegetables cheaply.
items.why: Day 5's きかく group — 規格 (a standard/spec) shares this reading with 企画 (planning).

items.q: ある国ではひどい凶作により、農民が集団自殺を図った。
items.qr: Aru kuni de wa hidoi kyousaku ni yori, noumin ga shuudan jisatsu o hakatta.
items.en: In one country, a severe crop failure led farmers to attempt mass suicide.
items.why: Day 6's きょうさく group — 凶作 (a poor harvest) shares this reading with 共作 (a joint work).

items.q: 筋肉や血管に注射をする。
items.qr: Kinniku ya kekkan ni chuusha o suru.
items.en: Give an injection into muscle or a blood vessel.
items.why: Day 6's own title pair — 注射 (an injection) shares ちゅうしゃ with 駐車 (parking).

items.q: 貴社のますますの発展をお祈り申し上げます。
items.qr: Kisha no masumasu no hatten o oinori moushiagemasu.
items.en: We wish your company continued growth and success.
items.why: Day 6's きしゃ group — 貴社 (the honorific "your company," used in letters) shares this reading with 記者 (a reporter) and 汽車 (a steam train).

items.q: りんごのかわをむく。
items.qr: Ringo no kawa o muku.
items.en: Peel an apple.
items.why: Day 1's かわ group — 皮 is the kanji for a natural peel/skin (fruit, animal), distinct from 革 (tanned leather).

items.q: 言葉では言いあらわせない。
items.qr: Kotoba de wa ii-arawasenai.
items.en: It cannot be expressed in words.
items.why: Day 1's あらわす group — 言葉に表す ("put into words") uses 表す; 現す is for appearing/unmasking, not expressing in language.

items.q: 問題の解決につとめる。
items.qr: Mondai no kaiketsu ni tsutomeru.
items.en: Strive to resolve the problem.
items.why: Day 2's つとめる group — 問題の解決に努める (striving to solve a problem) is the book's own listed phrase for 努める.

items.q: 受付はしめきりました。
items.qr: Uketsuke wa shimekirimashita.
items.en: Reception has closed (the deadline has passed).
items.why: Day 3's しめる group lists 締め切る specifically as "to close by a deadline"; 閉める is for physically closing doors/lids, 絞める is to strangle, 占める is to occupy a share.

items.q: 合格するまでチョコレートをたちます。
items.qr: Goukaku suru made chokoreeto o tachimasu.
items.en: I will give up chocolate until I pass.
items.why: Day 3's たつ group lists both 酒を断つ (voluntarily giving up a habit/vice) and 食事を絶つ／断つ (fasting) — reasoned here as 断つ, since giving up an indulgence like chocolate as an act of willpower parallels 酒を断つ more closely than 絶つ's harsher "sever completely" sense (as in 命を絶つ). Flagged as the one genuinely ambiguous answer this week — the book's own entries show overlap between 絶つ and 断つ for "fasting/quitti

items.q: この子は左（ ）です。
items.qr: Kono ko wa hidari (___) desu.
items.en: This child is left-handed.
items.why: Day 1's きく group — 左利き (left-handed) uses 利き, from 利く ("to be sharp/dexterous").

items.q: （ ）海公園に遊びに行く。
items.qr: (___) kai kouen ni asobi ni iku.
items.en: Go to the seaside park to play.
items.why: Day 3's のぞむ group — 臨海公園 ("a seaside/waterfront park") uses 臨, from 海を臨む ("face the sea").

items.q: 船が（ ）波に沈んだ。
items.qr: Fune ga (___) nami ni shizunda.
items.en: The ship sank in rough waves.
items.why: Day 1's あらい group — 荒波 (rough/violent waves) uses 荒, describing turbulent nature; 粗い is for coarse texture/mesh, not sea conditions.

items.q: 何かとてもいいことがあったのか、妻は（ ）機嫌だ。
items.qr: Nanika totemo ii koto ga atta no ka, tsuma wa (___) kigen da.
items.en: Something must have gone very well — my wife is in a great mood.
items.why: Day 4's きげん group — 上機嫌 ("in a great mood") uses 上; 不機嫌 (bad mood) is the opposite, and 最/高 don't form standard collocations here.

items.q: 大学時代を（ ）意義に過ごす。
items.qr: Daigaku jidai o (___) igi ni sugosu.
items.en: Spend one's university years meaningfully.
items.why: Day 5's いぎ group — 有意義に ("meaningfully") uses 有, from 有意義な; the other options don't form real words with 意義 here.

items.q: 国民に隠されていた事実が（ ）になった。
items.qr: Kokumin ni kakusarete ita jijitsu ga (___) ni natta.
items.en: The fact that had been hidden from the public came to light.
items.why: 公になる is the fixed idiom for a hidden fact "becoming public"; 穴 (a hole) has no such idiomatic use with になる in this sense.

items.q: 家族の笑顔が私の元気の（ ）です。
items.qr: Kazoku no egao ga watashi no genki no (___) desu.
items.en: My family's smiles are the source of my energy.
items.why: 元気の源 "a source of energy" is a fixed phrase in this list; 塊 "a lump" describes a physical mass, not an abstract origin of energy.

items.q: 漢字の読み方を間違えて（ ）をかきました。
items.qr: Kanji no yomikata o machigaete (___) o kakimashita.
items.en: I embarrassed myself by misreading the kanji.
items.why: 恥をかく is the set phrase "to embarrass oneself"; 罪 refers to guilt/wrongdoing, which doesn't fit a simple reading mistake.

items.q: 悔しくて（ ）を噛んだ。
items.qr: Kuyashikute (___) o kanda.
items.en: I bit my lip in frustration.
items.why: 唇を噛む "bite one's lip" is the idiom for frustration/regret; 舌を噛む "bite one's tongue" describes an accidental slip of the tongue, not an emotional reaction.

items.q: 幼い子の立派な行動に大人は（ ）を正した。
items.qr: Osanai ko no rippa na koudou ni otona wa (___) o tadashita.
items.en: The adults straightened up in response to the young child's admirable behavior.
items.why: 襟を正す "straighten one's collar" is the fixed idiom for becoming respectful/serious; 丈 only means physical length (of a coat), it has no such idiomatic use.

items.q: この酒は、なかなか手に入らないので（ ）の酒と呼ばれている。
items.qr: Kono sake wa, nakanaka te ni hairanai node (___) no sake to yobarete iru.
items.en: This sake is hard to get, so it's called a "phantom" (extremely rare) sake.
items.why: 幻の酒 "phantom sake" is the set phrase for something so rare it is almost mythical; 紫 is simply a color and doesn't collocate with rarity.

items.q: 育児休暇を終えて、仕事に（ ）する。
items.qr: Ikuji kyuuka o oete, shigoto ni (___) suru.
items.en: After finishing childcare leave, she returns to work.
items.why: 仕事に復帰する is the fixed collocation for a person returning to their job; 復活 describes an event or custom being revived, not a person's own return.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: （ ）の用紙に必要事項を記入してください。
items.qr: (___) no youshi ni hitsuyou jikou o kinyuu shite kudasai.
items.en: Please fill in the required information on the prescribed form.

opts.en: a regulation (pairs with fees/rules, not forms)

items.why: 所定の用紙 "the prescribed form" is the set phrase for an officially designated document; 規定 collocates with fees/rules (規定の料金), not with a physical form.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: ネクタイやスーツは（ ）だ。もっと気楽な服装で出勤したい。
items.qr: Nekutai ya suutsu wa (___) da. Motto kiraku na fukusou de shukkin shitai.
items.en: Ties and suits are cramped/restrictive. I want to commute in more relaxed clothes.
items.why: 窮屈 describes something physically confining or restrictive, which fits stiff formal clothing; 退屈 means "boring" and applies to time or activities, not garments.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 被災地の（ ）支援をする。
items.qr: Hisaichi no (___) shien o suru.
items.en: We provide reconstruction support for the disaster-hit area.
items.why: 復興 is used for rebuilding a country, region, or economy after a disaster; 回復 is reserved for smaller-scale recovery like health or weather.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 彼は職務（ ）で減給になった。
items.qr: Kare wa shokumu (___) de genkyuu ni natta.
items.en: He had his pay cut for neglecting his duties.

opts.en: slow (describes motion, not a punishable fault)

items.why: 職務怠慢 "dereliction of duty" is the fixed phrase for neglecting one's responsibilities (a punishable fault); 緩慢 only describes slow physical movement.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 腰痛がひどくなり、日常生活に（ ）を来すようになった。
items.qr: Youtsuu ga hidoku nari, nichijou seikatsu ni (___) o kitasu you ni natta.
items.en: The back pain worsened until it began interfering with daily life.

opts.en: a technical fault (wrong scope for a person's life)

items.why: 支障を来す "cause hindrance" is the fixed phrase for something interfering with one's own life/work; 障害 more commonly describes a technical fault (signal, server) or a disability.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 返済・返却・返還

items.q: 人身事故のためダイヤが乱れています。予めご（ ）ください。
items.qr: Jinshin jiko no tame daiya ga midarete imasu. Arakajime go-(___) kudasai.
items.en: Train schedules are disrupted due to a person-involved accident. Please understand this in advance.

opts.en: consent (to a request — wrong register for an announcement)

items.why: ご了承ください is the fixed polite phrase for asking the public to accept an inconvenience in advance; 承諾 is for consenting to a specific request/demand between two parties, not a public announcement.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 時計を（ ）して掃除する。
items.qr: Tokei o (___) shite souji suru.
items.en: Take apart the clock to clean it.
items.why: 分解 is taking a physical object like a clock or machine apart; 分析 is examining data or results, not disassembling hardware.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 有害サイトの（ ）ができないように携帯電話を設定する。
items.qr: Yuugai saito no (___) ga dekinai you ni keitai denwa o settei suru.
items.en: Set up the phone so harmful websites cannot be browsed.
items.why: 閲覧 is the standard word for browsing/reading a website or document; 展覧 refers to a physical exhibition (of art, etc.), not viewing a webpage.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 漁船が（ ）し、乗組員全員が行方不明となった。
items.qr: Gyosen ga (___) shi, norikumiin zen'in ga yukue fumei to natta.
items.en: The fishing boat sank, and the entire crew went missing.
items.why: 沈没 specifically describes a boat/ship sinking in water; 没落 describes a family or fortune falling into decline over time, not a physical sinking.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: 仕事のために（ ）を利用する。
items.qr: Shigoto no tame ni (___) o riyou suru.
items.en: Use one's network of contacts for work.
items.why: 人脈 refers to a person's network of social/professional connections; 文脈 refers only to the context surrounding a piece of text.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: A社はB社との提携について（ ）を進めている。
items.qr: Ei-sha wa Bii-sha to no teikei ni tsuite (___) o susumete iru.
items.en: Company A is proceeding with negotiations over a partnership with Company B.
items.why: 交渉 is a formal, mutually agreed negotiation between two parties; 干渉 means unwanted interference in someone else's affairs, which doesn't fit a business partnership discussion.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 分解・分析・分類・分配

items.q: （ ）どの子どもにも愛情を注ぐ。
items.qr: (___) dono kodomo ni mo aijou o sosogu.
items.en: She pours affection on every child equally, without favoritism.
items.why: 分け隔てなく means "without discrimination between people," which fits loving every child equally; 懲りない means "not learning a lesson from a bad experience," an unrelated idea.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 論文を書き続けている先輩の（ ）見舞いに行った。
items.qr: Ronbun o kakitsuzukete iru senpai no (___) mimai ni itta.
items.en: I went to cheer on my senior who has been writing their thesis nonstop.

opts.en: a visit to cheer on someone hard at work
(only used in 謹賀新年, New Year greeting)

items.why: 陣中見舞い is specifically a visit to encourage someone who is deep in demanding work; 謹賀 only ever appears inside the New Year's greeting 謹賀新年, unrelated to visiting someone.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 大臣は時代（ ）な発言をした。
items.qr: Daijin wa jidai (___) na hatsugen o shita.
items.en: The minister made an anachronistic (out-of-touch) remark.

opts.en: an illusion (only pairs with 目の, not 時代)

items.why: 時代錯誤 "anachronism" is the fixed compound for being out of step with the times; 錯覚 only combines with 目の (an optical illusion), not 時代.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 妹は感情の（ ）が激しい。
items.qr: Imouto wa kanjou no (___) ga hageshii.
items.en: My younger sister has intense emotional ups and downs.
items.why: 感情の起伏 "emotional ups and downs" is the fixed phrase for mood swings; 妥協 "compromise" describes negotiation between people, unrelated to one's own emotions.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: （ ）書類に目を通す。
items.qr: (___) shorui ni me o toosu.
items.en: Look over the attached documents.
items.why: 添付書類 "attached documents" only makes sense with email/files; 扶養 describes financially supporting a family member, not a document.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 母はめったに（ ）をこぼさない。
items.qr: Haha wa mettani (___) o kobosanai.
items.en: My mother rarely complains.
items.why: 愚痴をこぼす "voice a complaint" is a fixed idiom (literally "spill out a grumble"); 炊事 "cooking/housework" is just a noun with no idiomatic link to こぼす.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 融通が利く・便宜を図る

items.q: 「た」はにごっていない音、つまり（ ）です。
items.qr: "Ta" wa nigotte inai oto, tsumari (___) desu.
items.en: "Ta" is an unvoiced sound — in other words, a 清音.
items.why: The sentence describes a sound that is "not voiced" (にごっていない) — that is precisely the definition of 清音; 濁音 is the voiced counterpart, the opposite of what's described.

items.q: （ ）なのはいいことだが、たまには大胆になってみてはどうか。
items.qr: (___) na no wa ii koto da ga, tama ni wa daitan ni natte mite wa dou ka.
items.en: Being careful is good, but why not try being bold once in a while?

opts.en: precious, valuable (not the antonym of 大胆)

items.why: The sentence sets up a contrast with 大胆 "bold" — its true antonym in this list is 慎重 "careful"; 貴重 "precious" is an unrelated word that merely sounds similar.

items.q: この道路は（ ）的に渋滞している。
items.qr: Kono douro wa (___) teki ni juutai shite iru.
items.en: This road is chronically congested.

opts.en: leisurely (describes a manner, not a recurring state)

items.why: 慢性的に "chronically" describes a persistent, recurring state like traffic congestion; 悠長 describes an unhurried manner or pace, not a state that keeps recurring — a cross-family trap since both can sound plausible before 的に.

items.q: 先頭を走るランナーとの距離を（ ）追いついた。
items.qr: Sentou o hashiru rannaa to no kyori o (___) oitsuita.
items.en: Closing the gap with the lead runner, he caught up.
items.why: Catching up means shrinking the gap, so 縮める "shorten" is correct; 伸ばす "lengthen/stretch" would mean widening the gap, the opposite of catching up.

items.q: 信念は頑固に曲げないが、表現の仕方には（ ）さがある。
items.qr: Shinnen wa ganko ni magenai ga, hyougen no shikata ni wa (___) sa ga aru.
items.en: He won't bend his convictions, but there's flexibility in how he expresses them.
items.why: The sentence contrasts 頑固 "stubborn" with its true antonym 柔軟 "flexible"; 膨張 describes physical/numeric expansion, unrelated to personal attitude.

items.q: いつもの食事は質素だが、家族の誕生日には（ ）な料理を作る。
items.qr: Itsumo no shokuji wa shisso da ga, kazoku no tanjoubi ni wa (___) na ryouri o tsukuru.
items.en: Everyday meals are simple, but on a family birthday, I make a lavish spread.
items.why: The sentence contrasts everyday 質素 "frugal" meals with its antonym 豪華 "lavish" for a birthday; 勇敢 "brave" describes courage, unrelated to food.

items.q: （ ）を繰り返して、ついに成功した。
items.qr: (___) o kurikaeshite, tsui ni seikou shita.
items.en: After repeated trial and error, I finally succeeded.

opts.en: alternating joy and worry (no link to eventual success)

items.why: 試行錯誤 describes a repeated process of attempting and failing that eventually leads to success; 一喜一憂 describes being emotionally swayed by each individual outcome, not a path toward success.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: マニュアル通りではなく、（ ）に対応してほしい。
items.qr: Manyuaru doori de wa naku, (___) ni taiou shite hoshii.
items.en: I want you to respond flexibly to the situation, not just follow the manual.
items.why: 臨機応変 describes adapting one's approach to fit the situation, which is what's being requested; 支離滅裂 describes incoherent, disorganized behavior — the opposite of a positive quality to request.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: 男は会社を首になり、（ ）になって犯行に及んだという。
items.qr: Otoko wa kaisha o kubi ni nari, (___) ni natte hankou ni oyonda to iu.
items.en: It's said the man was fired and, falling into desperation, committed the crime.

opts.en: groping in the dark for a solution (not a state that leads to crime)

items.why: 自暴自棄 describes giving up on oneself and acting recklessly/destructively, matching a fired man turning to crime; 暗中模索 describes searching for a solution blindly, not a state of reckless despair.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: 美辞麗句を並べないで、（ ）に言ってくれませんか。
items.qr: Bijireiku o narabenaide, (___) ni itte kuremasen ka.
items.en: Could you just tell me straightforwardly, without flowery language?

opts.en: rounding up all at once (unrelated to speaking style)

items.why: 単刀直入 is the direct opposite of using flowery language — speaking plainly and to the point; 一網打尽 describes catching everything at once, unrelated to speaking manner.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: 唯一無二の親友が受賞して、私も（ ）です。
items.qr: Yuiitsu muni no shin'yuu ga jushou shite, watashi mo (___) desu.
items.en: My one-and-only best friend won an award, and I too am overcome with emotion.
items.why: 感慨無量 describes being overwhelmed with emotion at a meaningful moment, matching a friend's award; 新陳代謝 is a purely biological term for metabolism, unrelated to feelings.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: （ ）するばかりで、役に立たない手伝いなら不要だ。
items.qr: (___) suru bakari de, yaku ni tatanai tetsudai nara fuyou da.
items.en: If all the "help" does is scramble about in confusion and achieve nothing, it's not needed.
items.why: 右往左往 describes running about uselessly without direction, matching "help that's not helpful"; 創意工夫 is a positive trait (ingenuity), which would contradict calling the help useless.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 6 · 単刀直入・一言一句

items.q: この辺りは趣のある店が並んでいる。
items.qr: Kono atari wa omomuki no aru mise ga narande iru.
items.en: This area is lined with shops that have real character.
items.why: Day 1's 概念 group — 趣のある庭 "a tasteful garden" uses the same reading おもむき.

items.q: 選手たちは技を磨いて試合に臨んだ。
items.qr: Senshu-tachi wa waza o migaite shiai ni nozonda.
items.en: The athletes honed their skills and faced the match.
items.why: Day 1's 概念 group — 技を磨く "improve one's skill" reads 技 as わざ.

items.q: 手のひらの静脈で本人を認証するシステムがある。
items.qr: Te no hira no joumyaku de honnin o ninshou suru shisutemu ga aru.
items.en: There is a system that authenticates a person by the veins in their palm.

opts.en: (not a real reading of 静脈)

items.why: Day 3's 脈 family — 静脈 (⇔動脈) reads じょうみゃく, "a vein."

items.q: 志を果たして故郷に帰る。
items.qr: Kokorozashi o hatashite kokyou ni kaeru.
items.en: Having realized my aspiration, I return to my hometown.
items.why: Day 1's 概念 group — 志を果たす "realize one's aspirations" reads 志 as こころざし.

items.q: あの役人の行為は腹に据えかねる。
items.qr: Ano yakunin no koui wa hara ni suekaneru.
items.en: That official's conduct is infuriating beyond endurance.

opts.en: set, place (as in 据えかねる)

items.why: Day 4's emotional-reactions group — 腹に据えかねる "unable to hold back one's anger" reads 据え as すえ.

items.q: 推薦入学で高校に入る。
items.qr: Suisen nyuugaku de koukou ni hairu.
items.en: Enter high school through recommendation-based admission.
items.why: Day 2's 推 family — 推薦入学 "admission by recommendation" reads 推薦 as すいせん (推奨/すいしょう is the near-relative, but means endorsement of a solution/product, not admission).

items.q: 彼は炊事、洗濯、掃除、何でもできます。
items.qr: Kare wa suiji, sentaku, souji, nan demo dekimasu.
items.en: He can do cooking, laundry, cleaning — anything.

opts.en: housework in general (close, but wrong reading of 炊事)

items.why: Day 4's everyday-sayings group — 炊事・洗濯 "cooking and laundry" reads 炊事 as すいじ.

items.q: 扶養家族がいると所得税が控除される。
items.qr: Fuyou kazoku ga iru to shotokuzei ga koujo sareru.
items.en: Having dependents earns an income-tax deduction.
items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 扶養家族 "dependents" reads 扶養 as ふよう.

items.q: 私は大ざっぱですが、息子は几帳面です。
items.qr: Watashi wa oozappa desu ga, musuko wa kichoumen desu.
items.en: I'm sloppy, but my son is meticulous.
items.why: Day 5's style-and-discipline pair — 几帳面 (⇔大ざっぱ) reads きちょうめん.

items.q: 悠長にしている暇はない。迅速に対応するように。
items.qr: Yuuchou ni shite iru hima wa nai. Jinsoku ni taiou suru you ni.
items.en: There's no time to be leisurely. Respond promptly.

opts.en: promptly (adverb, wrong reading of this word)

items.why: Day 5's pace-and-depth pair — 迅速 (⇔悠長) reads じんそく.

items.q: 不法とうきは罰せられます。
items.qr: Fuhou touki wa basserare masu.
items.en: Illegal dumping is punishable.
items.why: Day 6's problem-solving group — 不法投棄 "illegal dumping" uses 投棄, not the homophones 陶器/登記/冬季.

items.q: ごらく施設の充実を図る。
items.qr: Goraku shisetsu no juujitsu o hakaru.
items.en: Aim to improve entertainment facilities.
items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 娯楽施設 "entertainment facility" uses 娯楽, read ごらく.

items.q: ふきつな予感が的中する。
items.qr: Fukitsu na yokan ga tekichuu suru.
items.en: An ominous premonition comes true.
items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 不吉な予感 "an ominous premonition" uses 不吉, read ふきつ.

items.q: よめ姑の関係はなかなか大変だ。
items.qr: Yome shuutome no kankei wa nakanaka taihen da.
items.en: The daughter-in-law/mother-in-law relationship is quite hard.

opts.en: marriage (wrong kanji, not a standalone noun here)

items.why: Day 5's fortune-and-relations pair — 嫁 (⇔婿) is "a daughter-in-law," read よめ.

items.q: 今朝は庭一面にしもが降りていた。
items.qr: Kesa wa niwa ichimen ni shimo ga orite ita.
items.en: This morning the whole garden was covered in frost.
items.why: Day 1's 気象 group — 霜が降りる "frost forms" uses 霜, read しも.

items.q: 子どもと一緒に観覧（ ）に乗る。
items.qr: Kodomo to issho ni kanran (___) ni noru.
items.en: Ride the Ferris wheel together with the kids.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 観覧車 "a Ferris wheel" is the fixed compound (literally "a viewing vehicle").

items.q: 回覧（ ）を隣に回す。
items.qr: Kairan (___) o tonari ni mawasu.
items.en: Pass the neighborhood circular notice to next door.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 回覧板 "circulation board" is the fixed compound used by neighborhood associations.

items.q: 閲覧（ ）で新聞や雑誌を読む。
items.qr: Etsuran (___) de shinbun ya zasshi o yomu.
items.en: Read newspapers and magazines in the reading room.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 閲覧室 "reading room" is the fixed compound for a library's reading area.

items.q: 展覧（ ）に招待される。
items.qr: Tenran (___) ni shoutai sareru.
items.en: Be invited to an exhibition.
items.why: Day 3's 覧 family — 展覧会 "an exhibition" is the fixed compound for a public display of art/works.

items.q: 妥協（ ）を検討する。
items.qr: Dakyou (___) o kentou suru.
items.en: Consider a compromise plan.

opts.en: (not this compound; cf. 傑作/駄作)

items.why: Day 4's work-and-social-life group — 妥協案／妥協策 "a compromise plan/measure" fixes 案 (or 策) after 妥協.

items.q: 神社で試験の合格を（ ）。
items.qr: Jinja de shiken no goukaku o (___).
items.en: I pray at the shrine for success on the exam.
items.why: 合格を祈る ("pray for success") is the fixed collocation; 折る means to physically fold or break something, which cannot take 合格 as its object.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 結婚式で（ ）の愛を誓う。
items.qr: Kekkonshiki de (___) no ai o chikau.
items.en: At the wedding, they vow eternal love.
items.why: 永遠の愛 ("eternal love") is the standard wedding-vow phrase; 因縁 describes a fated/karmic connection (often ominous), not a romantic vow.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 踏み切りで立ち（ ）していた車に電車が突っ込んだ。
items.qr: Fumikiri de tachi (___) shite ita kuruma ni densha ga tsukkonda.
items.en: A train crashed into a car that was stranded at the railway crossing.

opts.en: bewilderment (not a fixed set phrase here)

items.why: 立ち往生 is the fixed idiom for a vehicle stuck/stranded in place; 困惑 describes a person's mental bewilderment, not a stalled car.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 子どもたちを取り（ ）環境の変化について講演する。
items.qr: Kodomotachi o tori (___) kankyou no henka ni tsuite kouen suru.
items.en: He gives a lecture on the changes in the environment surrounding children.
items.why: 取り巻く環境 ("the surrounding environment") is a fixed collocation; 率いる means to lead/command people, not to surround an abstract environment.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 仕事の（ ）を上げるために、歩くことが有効だそうだ。
items.qr: Shigoto no (___) o ageru tame ni, aruku koto ga yuukou da sou da.
items.en: Apparently, walking is effective for raising work efficiency.

opts.en: thought (doesn't collocate with 上げる here)

items.why: 能率を上げる ("raise efficiency") is the standard collocation; 思考 (thought/thinking) isn't something you "raise" with a verb like 上げる in this sense.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 姉は文章を書くのに（ ）いる。
items.qr: Ane wa bunshou o kaku no ni (___) iru.
items.en: My older sister excels at writing.
items.why: ～に秀でている means "excels at ~"; 老いる means "to grow old" and has nothing to do with writing skill — a pure shape-confusion trap (老 vs 秀 share the 耂-ish top).
items.unit: Week 7 Day 1 · 困る・原因・囚人

items.q: 東大を出て、官僚になり、（ ）なエリートコースを歩む。
items.qr: Todai o dete, kanryou ni nari, (___) na eriito koosu o ayumu.
items.en: Graduating from Tokyo University and becoming a bureaucrat, he walks the typical elite career path.
items.why: 典型的なエリートコース ("the typical/textbook elite path") describes a well-known pattern; 象徴的 means "symbolic," which doesn't fit describing a career route.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 日本に来たばかりの頃は慣れない環境に（ ）。
items.qr: Nihon ni kita bakari no koro wa narenai kankyou ni (___).
items.en: When I had just arrived in Japan, I was bewildered by the unfamiliar environment.
items.why: 戸惑う describes confusion from an unfamiliar situation; 悔やむ means to regret a past action, which doesn't fit "being new to an environment."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 監督は部員の（ ）才能に気づいた。
items.qr: Kantoku wa buin no (___) sainou ni kizuita.
items.en: The coach noticed a team member's hidden talent.
items.why: 隠れた才能 ("hidden talent") is a fixed collocation; 奏でる means "to play an instrument," which doesn't describe a quality of talent itself.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 弱いからといって相手を（ ）はいけない。
items.qr: Yowai kara to itte aite o (___) wa ikenai.
items.en: Just because someone seems weak doesn't mean you should look down on them.
items.why: 侮る means "to belittle/underestimate," matching "shouldn't look down on someone for being weak"; 微笑する just means "to smile."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: ゆで卵の（ ）をむく。
items.qr: Yudetamago no (___) o muku.
items.en: Peel the shell off a boiled egg.
items.why: A hard covering like an eggshell or seashell is 殻; 皮 is used for soft skins/peels (fruit, vegetables, animal skin), not a hard shell.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: ウイルスの（ ）経路を調べる。
items.qr: Uirusu no (___) keiro o shiraberu.
items.en: Investigate the virus's route of infection.
items.why: 感染経路 ("route of infection") is a fixed epidemiological term; 累積 means "cumulative buildup," which doesn't pair with "route."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 2 · 隠れる・穏やか

items.q: 新人のアナウンサーが原稿を（ ）読みしている。
items.qr: Shinjin no anaunsaa ga genkou o (___) yomi shite iru.
items.en: The rookie announcer is reading the script in a flat monotone.

opts.en: mistaken (誤読み isn't a standard word here)

items.why: 棒読み is the fixed word for reading in a flat, expressionless tone, exactly describing a rookie reading from a script; 誤読 exists as "misreading" but not as "誤読み" in this construction.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: ほぼ準備はできたので、あとは各自で（ ）調整してください。
items.qr: Hobo junbi wa dekita node, ato wa kakuji de (___) chousei shite kudasai.
items.en: Preparations are mostly done, so please make your own small adjustments from here.

opts.en: tiny (豆調整 isn't a real word)

items.why: 微調整 ("fine-tuning") is the standard word for small adjustments; 豆 attaches to nouns like 知識 or 電球, not to 調整.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: この薬はよく効くが（ ）作用がある。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa yoku kiku ga (___) sayou ga aru.
items.en: This medicine works well, but it has side effects.
items.why: 副作用 ("side effect") is the fixed medical term; 助 attaches to roles like 監督 or 動詞, not to 作用.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: （ ）事情により、この度会社を辞めることになりました。
items.qr: (___) jijou ni yori, kono tabi kaisha o yameru koto ni narimashita.
items.en: Due to various circumstances, I have decided to leave the company.

opts.en: sudden (急事情 isn't a set phrase)

items.why: 諸事情 is the standard euphemism for "various (unspecified) reasons," commonly used when resigning; 急 would need a different noun, like 急用.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: 彼にそんな特技があったなんて（ ）耳です。
items.qr: Kare ni sonna tokugi ga atta nante (___) mimi desu.
items.en: This is the first I've heard that he has such a skill.
items.why: 初耳 is a fixed idiom meaning "news to me / first time hearing this"; 真 attaches to nouns like 犯人 (真犯人), not to 耳.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: そうしていただけるなら、私にとっては（ ）都合です。
items.qr: Sou shite itadakeru nara, watashi ni totte wa (___) tsugou desu.
items.en: If you could do that, it would be convenient for me.
items.why: 好都合 ("convenient/favorable") is the fixed word; 高 attaches to measurable things (高性能, 高学歴), not to an abstract 都合. Both share the same reading こう, a common trap.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 3 · 再検査・再編成

items.q: 祖母は耳が遠いので（ ）が必要だ。
items.qr: Sobo wa mimi ga tooi node (___) ga hitsuyou da.
items.en: My grandmother is hard of hearing, so she needs a hearing aid.
items.why: 補聴器 ("hearing aid") is worn to help hearing; 聴診器 is the doctor's stethoscope, a completely different device that just happens to share the reading しんき/ちょうき pattern.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 習ったことはないので、（ ）で花を生けます。
items.qr: Naratta koto wa nai node, (___) de hana o ikemasu.
items.en: I've never taken lessons, so I arrange flowers my own self-taught way.
items.why: "Never took lessons" implies no formal style was learned, so it must be 自己流 ("my own way"); 日本流 names a specific, learnable national style, which contradicts the sentence.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 伝統芸能の後継者不足に（ ）を抱く。
items.qr: Dentou geinou no koukeisha busoku ni (___) o idaku.
items.en: He feels a sense of crisis about the shortage of successors in traditional arts.
items.why: A shortage of successors is worrying, matching 危機感 ("sense of crisis"); 充実感 describes a positive feeling of fulfillment, the opposite emotional direction.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 土地の（ ）をめぐって争う。
items.qr: Tochi no (___) o megutte arasou.
items.en: They fight over the ownership of the land.

opts.en: copyright (wrong domain — creative works, not land)

items.why: 所有権 applies to physical property like land; 著作権 specifically protects creative/intellectual works, not real estate.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 今日は（ ）に欠け、作業が進まない。
items.qr: Kyou wa (___) ni kake, sagyou ga susumanai.
items.en: Today I'm lacking in concentration, and the work isn't progressing.

opts.en: a feeling of fatigue (doesn't fit ～に欠け)

items.why: ～に欠ける ("to lack ~") pairs naturally with an ability noun like 集中力; 疲労感 is a feeling you "have," not an ability you "lack."
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: このシャッターは（ ）です。
items.qr: Kono shattaa wa (___) desu.
items.en: This shutter is electrically operated.
items.why: ～式 describes a style/mode of operation, fitting "electrically operated"; 計算機 is a noun for a specific device (a calculator), not a description of how a shutter works.
items.unit: Week 7 Day 4 · 選挙権・著作権

items.q: 醤油を（ ）瓶で買った。
items.qr: Shouyu o (___) bin de katta.
items.en: I bought soy sauce in a traditional 1.8-liter bottle.

opts.en: an area unit (wrong domain — area, not volume)

items.why: 一升瓶 is the fixed term for the classic large soy-sauce/sake bottle; 坪 measures land/floor area, not liquid volume.

items.q: （ ）にとどまらず、あちこちに住んでみたい。
items.qr: (___) ni todomarazu, achikochi ni sunde mitai.
items.en: I'd like to live in many different places, not just stay in one house.
items.why: 一軒家 ("a single house") fits "not staying in one house, wanting to live all over"; 一箇所 ("one spot") is a place counter, not a housing type.

items.q: （ ）で漢字の辞書を引く。
items.qr: (___) de kanji no jisho o hiku.
items.en: Look up a kanji dictionary by stroke count.
items.why: Kanji dictionaries are indexed by 画数 (number of strokes); 枚数 counts flat sheets of paper, unrelated to dictionary lookup.

items.q: 1坪は2（ ）くらいの広さだ。
items.qr: Hitotsubo wa ni (___) kurai no hirosa da.
items.en: One tsubo is about the size of two tatami mats.
items.why: The table's own note confirms 1坪 ≈ 2畳; 階 counts building floors, an unrelated unit of "height," not area.

items.q: 母は（ ）も同じことを言うようになった。
items.qr: Haha wa (___) mo onaji koto o iu you ni natta.
items.en: My mother has started saying the same thing over and over.
items.why: 何遍も ("time and time again") counts repeated actions; 隻 counts large ships, irrelevant to "saying something."

items.q: 食パンを（ ）ください。
items.qr: Shokupan o (___) kudasai.
items.en: A loaf of bread, please.
items.why: 斤 is the dedicated counter for loaves of sliced bread; 錠 counts pills/tablets, an unrelated small solid object.

items.q: 神社に試験の合格を祈願する。
items.qr: Jinja ni shiken no goukaku o kigan suru.
items.why: Day 1's 祈 cluster gives 祈願 (きがん) directly — "praying at a shrine for success."

items.q: 彼は後輩から慕われている。
items.qr: Kare wa kouhai kara shitawarete iru.
items.why: Day 1's 墓・暮・募・慕・幕 cluster gives 慕う (したう) — "he is looked up to by his juniors."

items.q: 便宜上、その人をAさんと呼ぶことにします。
items.qr: Bengijou, sono hito o Ei-san to yobu koto ni shimasu.
items.why: Day 2's 宜 cluster gives 適宜 (てきぎ) and 便宜上 (べんぎじょう) — "for convenience's sake."

items.q: 私は派遣社員から正社員になった。
items.qr: Watashi wa haken shain kara seishain ni natta.
items.why: Day 2's 遺・遣 cluster gives 派遣 (はけん) — "I went from being a dispatched (temp) worker to a full employee."

items.q: 遺族に対して哀悼の意を表した。
items.qr: Izoku ni taishite aitou no i o arawashita.
items.why: Day 2's 哀・衰 cluster gives 哀悼 (あいとう) — "expressed condolences to the bereaved family."

items.q: 「奉仕品」というのは安売りのことだ。
items.qr: "Houshi hin" to iu no wa yasuuri no koto da.
items.why: Day 2's 奉・奏 cluster gives 奉仕 (ほうし) — "a service item" is a Japanese retail term for a discounted bargain good.

items.q: その商品は在庫がございます。
items.qr: Sono shouhin wa zaiko ga gozaimasu.
items.why: Day 2's 存・在 cluster gives 在庫 (ざいこ) — "that item is in stock."

items.q: ピアノの伴奏で歌を歌う。
items.qr: Piano no bansou de uta o utau.
items.why: Day 2's 奉・奏 cluster gives 伴奏 (ばんそう) — "singing to piano accompaniment."

items.q: 平穏無事な毎日を送る。
items.qr: Heion buji na mainichi o okuru.
items.why: Day 2's title kanji 穏 gives 平穏 (へいおん) — "living a peaceful, uneventful daily life."

items.q: あの日のことは今でも鮮明に覚えている。
items.qr: Ano hi no koto wa ima demo senmei ni oboete iru.
items.why: Day 6's 鮮明な cluster gives せんめい — "I still remember that day vividly."

items.q: ゆいごん状を書いておく。
items.qr: Yuigon jou o kaite oku.
items.why: Day 2's headline confusion pair 遺 vs 遣 — a will is 遺言, written with "leave behind," never 遣.

items.q: さよならまんるいホームランで勝った。
items.qr: Sayonara manrui hoomuran de katta.
items.why: Day 2's 塁・累 cluster gives 満塁 (まんるい) — "won with a walk-off grand slam."

items.q: はものの持ち込みは禁止されています。
items.qr: Hamono no mochikomi wa kinshi sarete imasu.
items.why: Day 1's 力・刀・刃 cluster gives 刃物 (はもの) — "bringing in blades is prohibited."

items.q: お金とは一生えんがないだろうと占い師に言われた。
items.qr: Okane to wa isshou en ga nai darou to uranaishi ni iwareta.
items.why: Day 1's 緑・録・縁 cluster gives 縁 (えん) — "the fortune-teller said I'd never have a connection with money."

items.q: そぼくな疑問をぶつけてみた。
items.qr: Soboku na gimon o butsukete mita.
items.why: Day 1's 牧・枚・朴 cluster gives 素朴な (そぼく) — "I raised a naive/basic question."

items.q: 飛行機は（ ）気流に巻き込まれた。
items.qr: Hikouki wa (___) kiryuu ni makikomareta.
items.why: Day 3's 中級 cluster gives 乱気流 (らんきりゅう) — "the plane was caught in turbulence."

items.q: エコーと呼ばれる（ ）音波による検査を受ける。
items.qr: Ekoo to yobareru (___) onpa ni yoru kensa o ukeru.
items.why: Day 3's 初級 cluster gives 超音波 (ちょうおんぱ) — the fixed term for medical ultrasound ("echo").

items.q: 真っ暗は嫌なので、（ ）電球だけつけて寝ます。
items.qr: Makkura wa iya na node, (___) denkyuu dake tsukete nemasu.
items.why: Day 3's 上級 cluster gives 豆電球 (まめでんきゅう) — "I sleep with just a small night-light on since I hate total darkness."

items.q: 日本（ ）公開の古い映画を見に行く。
items.qr: Nihon (___) koukai no furui eiga o mi ni iku.
items.why: Day 3's 中級 cluster gives 初公開 (はつこうかい) — "going to see an old movie's Japan premiere."

items.q: （ ）文化間コミュニケーションを学ぶ。
items.qr: (___) bunka kan komyunikeeshon o manabu.
items.why: Day 3's 中級 cluster gives 異文化 (いぶんか) — "studying cross-cultural communication."

items.q: 市長は市立博物館の館長を（ ）して組織を一新したいと述べた。
items.qr: Shichou wa shiritsu hakubutsukan no kanchou o (___) shite soshiki o isshin shitai to nobeta.
items.en: The mayor said he wants to replace the city museum's director and renew the organization.
items.why: 更迭 targets a person in a post being replaced — exactly "館長を更迭する"; 統合 means merging/integrating organizations or systems, not swapping out one person.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 新（ ）が発足してから1年が経過した。
items.qr: Shin (___) ga hossoku shite kara ichi-nen ga keika shita.
items.en: A year has passed since the new cabinet was formed.
items.why: 内閣発足 (the cabinet's formation/launch) is the book's own fixed collocation; 閣僚 refers to individual ministers, who are appointed, not "launched" as a group.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 公共事業をめぐる（ ）事件で町長が起訴された。
items.qr: Koukyou jigyou o meguru (___) jiken de choushou ga kiso sareta.
items.en: The town mayor was indicted in a bribery scandal involving public works.

opts.en: dismissal (an action, not a type of scandal)

items.why: 贈収賄事件 (bribery scandal/case) is the standard news term for a giving-and-receiving-bribes case; 罷免 is the separate act of formally dismissing someone from a post, not a kind of "事件."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: （ ）改正について考える会が開かれた。
items.qr: (___) kaisei ni tsuite kangaeru kai ga hirakareta.
items.en: A meeting was held to think about constitutional reform.

opts.en: unconstitutional (a state, not a document to amend)

items.why: 憲法改正 (constitutional amendment) is the fixed phrase — you amend the 憲法 itself; 違憲 describes something being unconstitutional, and "違憲を改正する" is not meaningful.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 選挙に出馬というのは（ ）するという意味だ。
items.qr: Senkyo ni shutsuba to iu no wa (___) suru to iu imi da.
items.en: "Running (出馬) in an election" means to stand as a candidate.
items.why: 出馬 and 立候補 are near-synonyms for entering a race as a candidate; 総辞職 is a cabinet or group stepping down together — the opposite kind of event.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 来月中旬に日米（ ）会談が開かれる予定だ。
items.qr: Raigetsu chuujun ni Nichi-Bei (___) kaidan ga hirakareru yotei da.
items.en: A Japan-US summit is scheduled to be held in the middle of next month.

opts.en: alliance (the relationship itself, not the meeting)

items.why: 首脳会談 (summit talks) is the standard term for a meeting between national leaders; 同盟 names the alliance relationship itself, not the meeting where leaders talk.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 1 · 政治について

items.q: 各地で大雨による（ ）警報が出される。
items.qr: Kakuchi de oo-ame ni yoru (___) keihou ga dasareru.
items.en: Flood warnings are issued in various places due to heavy rain.
items.why: 洪水警報 is the fixed term for a flood warning triggered by heavy rain; 津波 (tsunami) is caused by seismic activity, not rainfall.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 核実験を続ける国に対し、経済（ ）措置をとる。
items.qr: Kaku jikken o tsuzukeru kuni ni taishi, keizai (___) sochi o toru.
items.en: Economic sanction measures are taken against a country that continues nuclear testing.
items.why: 経済制裁措置 (economic sanction measures) is the book's own listed collocation for punishing a state; 救援 is aid given to victims, the opposite kind of action.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 森林（ ）の現状について環境省が報告をした。
items.qr: Shinrin (___) no genjou ni tsuite Kankyoushou ga houkoku o shita.
items.en: The Ministry of the Environment reported on the current state of deforestation.

opts.en: a disaster (too broad, no specific act)

items.why: 森林伐採 (deforestation/logging) is today's headline term and the book's fixed collocation; 災害 is a general disaster, not the specific act of cutting down forests.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 世界的な（ ）危機、穀物の不足などが心配されている。
items.qr: Sekaiteki na (___) kiki, kokumotsu no fusoku nado ga shinpai sarete iru.
items.en: A global food crisis and grain shortages are feared.

opts.en: hunger/starvation (a state, not this set phrase)

items.why: 食糧危機 (food crisis) is the book's own listed fixed phrase; 飢餓 names the resulting state of starvation rather than the crisis itself.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 海外の地震被災地で（ ）活動をする。
items.qr: Kaigai no jishin hisaichi de (___) katsudou o suru.
items.en: Relief activities are carried out in areas overseas struck by an earthquake.

opts.en: a request (an act of asking, not "活動")

items.why: 救援活動 (relief activities) is the book's own listed collocation; 要請 is the act of requesting help, not the activity of providing it.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: （ ）上の理由から、空港での検査を拒否した人がいる。
items.qr: (___) jou no riyuu kara, kuukou de no kensa o kyohi shita hito ga iru.
items.en: Some people have refused airport screening for religious reasons.
items.why: 宗教上の理由 (for religious reasons) is the book's own listed fixed phrase; 弁護 relates to legal defense, not personal-belief reasons for refusing an inspection.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 2 · 国際問題について

items.q: 食材の相次ぐ値上がりに庶民の食卓は（ ）を受けている。
items.qr: Shokuzai no aitsugu neagari ni shomin no shokutaku wa (___) o ukete iru.
items.en: Ordinary people's dinner tables are taking a hit from successive food-price hikes.

opts.en: an attack (too aggressive for a "dinner table")

items.why: 打撃を受ける (to take a hit/blow) is the natural collocation for something suffering economic harm; 攻撃 implies an aggressive act by an agent, which doesn't fit "食卓" (a dinner table).
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 円高差益を（ ）して値下げをする。
items.qr: Endaka saeki o (___) shite nesage o suru.
items.en: Prices are cut by returning the profit margin from yen appreciation.
items.why: 利益を還元する (return a profit to customers) is the book's own listed collocation; 返還 is used for returning territory or physical objects, not abstract profit margins.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: A社が子会社2社を吸収（ ）することになった。
items.qr: A-sha ga kogaisha ni-sha o kyuushuu (___) suru koto ni natta.
items.en: Company A is set to absorb and merge with its two subsidiaries.
items.why: 吸収合併 (absorption merger) is the book's own fixed phrase; 倒産 (bankruptcy) is something that happens to a company, not an action one company does to another.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 解雇等で職を失った人を対象に（ ）する国の制度がある。
items.qr: Kaiko tou de shoku o ushinatta hito o taishou ni (___) suru kuni no seido ga aru.
items.en: There is a national system that provides loans targeting people who lost their jobs through layoffs, etc.

opts.en: finance (the field, doesn't take する this way)

items.why: 融資する (to lend/finance someone) is a verb describing an act of lending; 金融 names the general field of finance and doesn't naturally take する to mean "lend to a person."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 男性に人気のファストフード店が女性や子どもの需要（ ）を検討している。
items.qr: Dansei ni ninki no fasuto fuudo-ten ga josei ya kodomo no juyou (___) o kentou shite iru.
items.en: A fast-food chain popular with men is considering tapping into demand from women and children.

opts.en: a profit (a noun, not something you "検討" as an action on demand)

items.why: 需要を開拓する (to cultivate/tap new demand) matches the book's own ◆新分野を開拓 pattern; 利益 (profit) is a result, not an action taken toward "需要."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 職業訓練と就職先（ ）の雇用支援制度を設ける。
items.qr: Shokugyou kunren to shuushoku-saki (___) no koyou shien seido o mookeru.
items.en: An employment support system is set up covering vocational training and job-placement mediation.

opts.en: recommendation (endorsing one candidate, not a placement service)

items.why: 就職先の斡旋 (job-placement mediation) is today's own vocabulary term for institutional employment-matching; 推薦 is a personal endorsement of one candidate, a narrower act.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 3 · 経済・産業について

items.q: 平均（ ）が年々更新されている。
items.qr: Heikin (___) ga nen'nen koushin sarete iru.
items.en: The average life expectancy is being renewed (extended) year after year.

opts.en: a lifetime (a span, not a measurable statistic here)

items.why: 平均寿命 (average life expectancy) is the book's own fixed statistical term; 生涯 names a person's whole lifetime as a span, not the average-年数 figure being "updated."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: この薬は、花粉症による目のかゆみや（ ）を抑えます。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa, kafunshou ni yoru me no kayumi ya (___) o osaemasu.
items.en: This medicine suppresses eye itchiness and inflammation caused by hay fever.

opts.en: pneumonia (a lung disease, unrelated to eyes)

items.why: 炎症 (inflammation) fits eye symptoms from allergies; 肺炎 (pneumonia) is specifically a lung infection, unrelated to hay-fever eye symptoms.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 保育所の職員が児童（ ）法違反で取り調べを受けた。
items.qr: Hoikusho no shokuin ga jidou (___) hou ihan de torishirabe o uketa.
items.en: A daycare employee was investigated for violating the Child Welfare Act.
items.why: 児童福祉法 (the Child Welfare Act) is a real Japanese law name, matching the book's own ◆児童福祉 entry; 奉仕 (service) isn't part of any such law's name.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 喘息など（ ）疾患のある人は、ワクチンを優先的に受けられます。
items.qr: Zensoku nado (___) shikkan no aru hito wa, wakuchin o yuusenteki ni ukeraremasu.
items.en: People with underlying conditions such as asthma can receive the vaccine on a priority basis.

opts.en: stomach and intestines (asthma isn't a GI example)

items.why: 基礎疾患 (underlying/pre-existing medical condition) is the book's own fixed phrase for comorbidities like asthma; 胃腸 refers specifically to the stomach/intestines, unrelated to asthma.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: ある病院で脳卒中の患者に自立歩行を（ ）し、効果を上げている。
items.qr: Aru byouin de nousocchuu no kanja ni jiritsu hokou o (___) shi, kouka o agete iru.
items.en: At one hospital, stroke patients are being encouraged to walk independently, with good results.
items.why: 奨励する fits promoting a therapeutic practice as institutional policy; 激励 is more about cheering on one person emotionally (e.g. a competing athlete), a different register.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 親が子どもに暴力を（ ）事件が相次いでいる。
items.qr: Oya ga kodomo ni bouryoku o (___) jiken ga aitsuide iru.
items.en: Incidents of parents using violence against their children are occurring one after another.
items.why: 暴力を振るう (to wield violence) is the book's own fixed collocation; 吐く combines with things "spit out" like words (吐く言葉), not with 暴力.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 4 · 医療・福祉・健康について

items.q: 登山ブームの中で（ ）件数も増加している。
items.qr: Tozan buumu no naka de (___) kensuu mo zouka shite iru.
items.en: Amid the mountain-climbing boom, the number of mountaineering accidents is also increasing.
items.why: 遭難 is the standard term for a mountaineering/maritime mishap; 侵略 refers to a military invasion and has nothing to do with hikers.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 現場に残された（ ）が容疑者のものと一致した。
items.qr: Genba ni nokosareta (___) ga yougisha no mono to icchi shita.
items.en: The fingerprints left at the scene matched the suspect's.

opts.en: a person's custody/identity (a person, not something left behind)

items.why: 指紋が一致する (fingerprints match) is the exact phrase from today's headline; 身柄 refers to a person's physical custody, not physical evidence that can "match."
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: （ ）されていた会社社長は無事保護された。
items.qr: (___) sarete ita kaisha shachou wa buji hogo sareta.
items.en: The company president, who had been kidnapped, was safely taken into protective custody.

opts.en: release (would make "was then safely protected" redundant)

items.why: The sentence needs the state the president was in *before* being rescued — kidnapped (誘拐された); 解放 (already released) would make the following "was safely protected" nonsensical.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 行政に失望し、選挙を（ ）した。
items.qr: Gyousei ni shitsubou shi, senkyo o (___) shita.
items.en: Disillusioned with the administration, he/she abstained from voting in the election.
items.why: 選挙を棄権する (abstaining from an election) is the book's own listed collocation; 黙秘 is specifically a suspect's right to remain silent under questioning, unrelated to voting.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 男は住居侵入の容疑で（ ）された。
items.qr: Otoko wa juukyo shinnyuu no yougi de (___) sareta.
items.en: The man was arrested on suspicion of trespassing.

opts.en: release (the opposite direction from "on suspicion of")

items.why: 容疑で逮捕される (arrested on suspicion of) is the standard news pattern; 容疑で釈放される (released on suspicion of) would be contradictory, since release resolves a suspicion rather than acting on it.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: MOMAという美術館の正式な（ ）をご存知ですか。
items.qr: MOMA to iu bijutsukan no seishiki na (___) o gozonji desu ka.
items.en: Do you know the official name of the museum called MOMA?

opts.en: self-styled (a person claiming a title, not an institution's real name)

items.why: 正式な名称 (official name) is the book's own listed phrase for a formal designation; 自称 describes a person self-declaring a title, not an institution's real name.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 5 · 事件・事故について

items.q: 違法薬物取り締まり強化で、抜き打ち（ ）検査を実施する。
items.qr: Ihou yakubutsu torishimari kyouka de, nukiuchi (___) kensa o jisshi suru.
items.en: With stronger crackdowns on illegal drugs, surprise urine tests are carried out.
items.why: 尿検査 (urine test) is the book's own listed collocation and the real-world method for drug testing; 腸 (intestines) has no such testing use.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 高度成長から経済大国への（ ）を振り返る。
items.qr: Koudo seichou kara keizai taikoku e no (___) o furikaeru.
items.en: Looking back at the transition from a period of rapid growth to becoming an economic power.
items.why: 変遷 (historical transition/changes) fits a decades-long economic narrative; 返還 refers to returning territory or objects, unrelated to describing gradual change.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 空港の拡張で（ ）被害が懸念される。
items.qr: Kuukou no kakuchou de (___) higai ga kenen sareru.
items.en: With the airport's expansion, damage from noise is a concern.

opts.en: a disturbance/riot (a commotion, not ambient sound)

items.why: 騒音 (noise, esp. from aircraft) is the correct term for the kind of pollution airport expansion causes; 騒動 describes an uproar or social disturbance, not ambient sound.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 被害者に（ ）にメールを送っていた男が捜査線上に浮かび上がった。
items.qr: Higaisha ni (___) ni meeru o okutte ita otoko ga sousa-senjou ni ukabiagatta.
items.en: A man who had frequently sent emails to the victim emerged as a person of interest in the investigation.

opts.en: prosperity (a noun, doesn't work adverbially here)

items.why: 頻繁に (frequently) is the adverbial form used before a verb like メールを送る; 繁栄 (prosperity) is a noun about economic/social flourishing, not usable this way.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: A氏がB球団の新（ ）に就任した。
items.qr: A-shi ga B kyuudan no shin (___) ni shuunin shita.
items.en: Mr. A has taken up the post of new manager of team B.

opts.en: a guest (an attendee, not a post one takes up)

items.why: 監督に就任する (to take up the post of manager) matches today's headline about a coach becoming an honorary citizen; 来賓 names an invited guest, not an appointed position.

items.q: （ ）化の進む村で、地域の振興と活性化を図るイベントが行われた。
items.qr: (___)-ka no susumu mura de, chiiki no shinkou to kasseika o hakaru ibento ga okonawareta.
items.en: In a village experiencing advancing depopulation, an event was held aiming at regional promotion and revitalization.

opts.en: overcrowding (happens in cities, not shrinking villages)

items.why: 過疎化 (depopulation) fits a village needing "regional revitalization"; 過密 describes overcrowding, the opposite demographic problem seen in large cities.
items.unit: Week 8 Day 6 · 社会について

items.q: 病気を克服して社会に復帰する。
items.qr: Byouki o kokufuku shite shakai ni fukki suru.
items.en: Overcome an illness and return to society.
items.why: Day 6's 克 entry gives 克服 (こくふく) directly, matching the "○○監督" headline about overcoming illness.

items.q: 児童虐待事件の再発防止に取り組む。
items.qr: Jidou gyakutai jiken no sai-hatsu boushi ni torikumu.
items.en: Work to prevent recurrence of child-abuse incidents.
items.why: Day 6's 虐 entry gives 虐待 (ぎゃくたい), matching the headline "頻繁に起こる児童虐待."

items.q: 皇太子様がA国首相を表敬訪問した。
items.qr: Koutaishi-sama ga A-koku shushou o hyoukei houmon shita.
items.en: The Crown Prince paid a courtesy visit to the Prime Minister of Country A.
items.why: Day 6's 皇 entry gives 皇太子 (こうたいし), the Crown Prince.

items.q: B市教育委員会は給食費の滞納に対して法的措置を申し立てた。
items.qr: B-shi kyouiku iinkai wa kyuushokuhi no tainou ni taishite houteki sochi o moushitateta.
items.en: City B's board of education filed for legal measures against unpaid school-lunch fees.
items.why: Day 2's 措 entry gives 措置 (そち), matching the book's own ◆法的措置.

items.q: エコカーの大衆化が進んでいる。
items.qr: Ekokaa no taishuuka ga susunde iru.
items.en: The popularization of eco-friendly cars is progressing.
items.why: Day 1's 衆 entry gives 大衆 (たいしゅう, the general public); 大衆化 extends it to mean "becoming mainstream/popularized."

items.q: 派遣法の改正で雇用情勢が悪化する懸念がある。
items.qr: Haken-hou no kaisei de koyou jousei ga akka suru kenen ga aru.
items.en: There are concerns that revising the temp-staffing law will worsen the employment situation.
items.why: Day 3's 関連語彙 gives 雇用 (こよう, employment) ⇔ 解雇 (かいこ, dismissal).

items.q: A工業が昨年来、高値を更新している。
items.qr: A Kougyou ga sakunen-rai, takane o koushin shite iru.
items.en: A Industries has been hitting new record-high prices since last year.
items.why: Day 3's 関連語彙 gives 高値更新 (たかねこうしん, a record-high price), a stock-market term.

items.q: 胃腸の調子が悪く吐き気もする。
items.qr: Ichou no choushi ga waruku hakike mo suru.
items.en: My stomach is upset, and I also feel nauseated.
items.why: Day 4's 吐 entry gives 吐き気 (はきけ, nausea).

items.q: 敵を欺くにはまず味方から、という表現があります。
items.qr: Teki o azamuku ni wa mazu mikata kara, to iu hyougen ga arimasu.
items.en: There's an expression: "to deceive the enemy, first deceive your own side."
items.why: Day 5's 欺 entry gives 欺く (あざむく, to deceive).

items.q: 少子化対策担当大臣が認可保育所を視察した。
items.qr: Shoushika taisaku tantou daijin ga ninka hoikusho o shisatsu shita.
items.en: The minister in charge of declining-birthrate countermeasures inspected a licensed daycare center.
items.why: Day 2's 策 entry lists ◆少子化対策 (measures against the declining birthrate) directly.

items.q: 救急搬送されたかんじゃが何軒もの病院で受け入れを拒否された。
items.qr: Kyuukyuu hansou sareta kanja ga nangen mo no byouin de ukeire o kyohi sareta.
items.en: A patient transported by ambulance was refused admission by numerous hospitals.
items.why: Day 4's 患 entry gives 患者 (かんじゃ, a patient) directly.

items.q: 働く母親の増加とともに保育園、たくじしょの需要が伸びている。
items.qr: Hataraku hahaoya no zouka to tomo ni hoikuen, takujisho no juyou ga nobite iru.
items.en: As the number of working mothers increases, demand for daycare centers and nurseries is growing.
items.why: Day 4's 託 entry gives 託児所 (たくじしょ, a nursery school) directly.

items.q: 高齢化社会におけるしょうがい学習センターの意義は大きい。
items.qr: Koureika shakai ni okeru shougai gakushuu sentaa no igi wa ookii.
items.en: Lifelong-learning centers carry great significance in an aging society.
items.why: Day 4's ◆生涯学習 (lifelong learning) is the exact fixed phrase needed here.

items.q: ごみの不法投棄はしょばつされます。
items.qr: Gomi no fuhou touki wa shobatsu saremasu.
items.en: Illegal dumping of garbage is penalized.
items.why: Day 5's 罰 entry gives 処罰 (しょばつ, to penalize) directly.

items.q: 野生の動物におそわれる事件が増えている。
items.qr: Yasei no doubutsu ni osowareru jiken ga fuete iru.
items.en: Incidents of being attacked by wild animals are increasing.
items.why: Day 5's 襲 entry gives 襲う → passive 襲われる (おそわれる, to be attacked), matching the book's own ◆クマに襲われる.

items.q: A市長選で当選の中山（ ）は、当選の喜びを次のように述べた。
items.qr: A-shichouusen de tousen no Nakayama (___) wa, tousen no yorokobi o tsugi no you ni nobeta.
items.en: Mr. Nakayama, elected in City A's mayoral race, described his joy at winning as follows.
items.why: Day 1's 氏 entry (○○氏) is exactly the formal way newspapers refer to named people.

items.q: 世論調査で内閣の支持（ ）が低下していることがわかった。
items.qr: Yoron chousa de naikaku no shiji (___) ga teika shite iru koto ga wakatta.
items.en: A public opinion poll found that the cabinet's approval rating has declined.
items.why: Day 1's 関連語彙 gives 支持率 (しじりつ, approval rating) directly.

items.q: B県知事は報道（ ）の質問に終始笑顔で答えた。
items.qr: B-ken chiji wa houdou (___) no shitsumon ni shuushi egao de kotaeta.
items.en: The governor of Prefecture B answered the press corps' questions with a smile throughout.
items.why: Day 1's 陣 entry gives 報道陣 (ほうどうじん, the assembled press), matching the book's own ◆報道陣に囲まれる.

items.q: 今回の選挙では保守（ ）が優勢とみられている。
items.qr: Konkai no senkyo de wa hoshu (___) ga yuusei to mirarete iru.
items.en: In this election, the conservative faction is seen as having the advantage.
items.why: Day 1's 派 entry gives 保守派 (the conservative faction), directly opposite 革新派 (the reformist faction).

items.q: 新聞の投書（ ）に投稿する。
items.qr: Shinbun no toushou (___) ni toukou suru.
items.en: Submit a piece to the newspaper's letters-to-the-editor column.
items.why: Day 6's 欄 entry gives 投書欄 (とうしょらん, the letters-to-the-editor section) directly.
